newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May industry output down 1.7 pct -- IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May industry output down 1.7 pct -- IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in May fell 1.7 percent from April, and increased 2.5 percent in comparison with May last year, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
"This trend was to be expected given the exceptional greater number of working days in April," the IBGE said in a statement.
The 2.5 percent year-on-year rise was the lowest since July 1996, the IBGE said.
Industrial production in the first five months of 1997 grew 5 percent, while in the last 12 months output rose 5.7 percent, the IBGE said.
Production in May decreased in 16 of the 20 industrial sectors covered by the IBGE survey.

Output of durable goods declined the most in May at 14.1 percent, followed by capital goods at 8 percent and semi- and non-durable goods at 5.8 percent, the IBGE said. ((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
